info.name: data-exchange-uc1-meter-data.vc-validation
info.description: Exercises the DEG `vcvalidator` middleware with a real did:web Verifiable Credential (issuer did:web:ameetdesh.github.io:ies-did, hosted on GitHub Pages). The valid case flows through the BAP caller (signed) so the full pipeline ACKs; negative cases POST directly to the BPP receiver, where vcvalidator runs outermost and NACKs before signature/schema validation. Run the data-exchange devkit first (install/: docker compose up -d). See workflows/run-vc-validation.sh for the CLI equivalent.
